dupe_test_cases.title: Job URL renders as "View Posting →" link opening in new tab
dupe_test_cases.description: When app.job_url is non-null, the URL is hyperlinked with target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer". Empty URLs show "No URL saved" instead.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. View the Job Tracker for a client with apps having job URLs
2. Expand an app that has a URL set
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The expanded panel shows "URL: " followed by the full URL as a blue underlined link. Clicking opens the URL in a new browser tab.

dupe_test_cases.title: Status filter chip + Clear link visible when statusFilter !== all
dupe_test_cases.description: When entering Job Tracker via a Dashboard tile click, the filter is pre-applied and a removable chip appears with the active status. Clicking Clear resets to "all".
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. From the Dashboard tab, click the INTERVIEWS tile
2. Land on the Job Tracker tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Top-right of the "THEIR APPLICATIONS" header shows "Filtered:" label followed by an orange pill reading "INTERVIEWING" and a "Clear" link in orange. Clicking Clear removes the chip and shows all apps.

dupe_test_cases.title: Empty applications state copy matches the filter
dupe_test_cases.description: With no filter: "No applications tracked yet." With filter: "No {status} applications." (status underscores replaced with spaces).
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Apply a filter that matches zero apps (e.g. offer filter on a client with no offers)
2. View the Job Tracker tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The applications section shows muted italic text "No offer applications." (with underscores converted to spaces).

dupe_test_cases.title: Notes tab eyebrow shows "NOTES for {clientName.toUpperCase()}"
dupe_test_cases.description: The tab header includes the client's name in uppercase. When name is null, suffix is omitted entirely (just "NOTES").
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client named "Josh Rosenblatt"
2. Click the "Notes" tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Orange uppercase eyebrow reads "NOTES FOR JOSH ROSENBLATT".

dupe_test_cases.title: Filter chips: All / Session Recap / Action Item / Other
dupe_test_cases.description: Filter row has 4 buttons. Active chip is orange-bordered + orange text + orange-tinted background; inactive chips are muted.
dupe_test_cases.steps: 1. Open the Notes tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: 4 filter chips render in a row: All (active by default — orange), Session Recap, Action Item, Other (all muted gray). Clicking any one switches active to that chip and updates the list.

dupe_test_cases.title: Filter applies ?type= query string to /note-feed endpoint
dupe_test_cases.description: Click on a non-"All" filter triggers a refetch with the filter applied. The notes list reloads with only matching types.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Notes tab with notes of all three types
2. Click the "Action Item" filter chip
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Network request shows GET /api/coach/clients/{clientId}/note-feed?type=action_item. The notes list re-renders showing only action_item notes.

dupe_test_cases.title: Action Item notes show priority badge + completion checkbox
dupe_test_cases.description: Only action_item type notes get a priority badge (Urgent/This Week/When Ready) and a leading checkbox. Session Recap and Other notes have neither.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Have a mix of all three note types
2. Open the Notes tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Each action_item card has: leading checkbox + orange "ACTION ITEM" type badge + colored priority badge (Urgent=red, This Week=orange, When Ready=blue). Session Recap and Other cards have only the type badge — no checkbox, no priority badge.

dupe_test_cases.title: Completed action items show ✓ Completed {date} and line-through body
dupe_test_cases.description: When completed_at is set, the card opacity drops to 60%, body text gets line-through, and a green "✓ Completed {date}" badge appears in the header.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Mark an action_item note complete via its checkbox
2. Observe the card's appearance
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The card dims to ~60% opacity. The body text shows strikethrough. The header gains a green "✓ Completed {today's date}" pill alongside the existing badges.

dupe_test_cases.title: Edit Save PUTs to /note-feed/[id] with body/type/priority
dupe_test_cases.description: The edit form serializes body (trimmed), type, and (if type=action_item) priority. PUT call refreshes the list on success.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "Edit" on a note
2. Modify the body and (if action_item) change priority
3. Click "Save"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Network shows PUT /api/coach/clients/{clientId}/note-feed/{noteId} with the modified payload. After Save, the form closes and the card re-renders with the new values. The qa notes table row reflects updated_at > created_at.

dupe_test_cases.title: Delete shows native confirm("Delete this note?")
dupe_test_cases.description: The Delete button does NOT have an inline confirm UI — it uses the browser's native confirm dialog. Cancelling preserves the note; confirming deletes it.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click the "Delete" button on a note
2. Observe the dialog
3. Click Cancel — note stays
4. Click Delete again, click OK
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Step 2 shows a native browser confirm dialog with the message "Delete this note?". Step 3: dialog closes, note remains in list. Step 4: dialog closes, DELETE /note-feed/{noteId} sent, list refetches, note no longer present.

dupe_test_cases.title: Add Note slide-in panel opens from right side, 460px wide
dupe_test_cases.description: Clicking "+ Add Note" in the persistent header strip opens AddNotePanel. Backdrop fades in; panel slides in with translateX transition.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "+ Add Note" in the orange header strip
2. Observe the panel animation
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: A backdrop fades to ~55% opacity. A 460px-wide panel slides in from the right edge. Header reads "NEW NOTE" (orange eyebrow) and "Add a note" (large bold). Body has TYPE pills (Session Recap default), NOTE textarea (focused), and Cancel/Save buttons.

dupe_test_cases.title: AddNotePanel save POSTs to /note-feed and refreshes Notes + NeedsAttention
dupe_test_cases.description: Save calls the onSubmit callback (POST /note-feed) and then triggers parent setState bumps so both the Notes tab and the Dashboard NeedsAttention section reload.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open AddNotePanel via "+ Add Note"
2. Select type=Action Item, priority=Urgent, type a note body
3. Click "Save note"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Network shows POST /api/coach/clients/{clientId}/note-feed with payload { type: "action_item", body: "...", priority: "urgent" }. Panel closes. The Notes tab list (if visible) shows the new note. If Dashboard tab is opened next, NeedsAttention section shows the new urgent item.

dupe_test_cases.title: Tab eyebrow shows "ALL ANALYSES FOR {clientName.toUpperCase()}"
dupe_test_cases.description: Header text uses the client's name in uppercase or "CLIENT" fallback.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client named "Lily Stein"
2. Click the "Analyses History" tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Orange eyebrow reads "ALL ANALYSES FOR LILY STEIN".

dupe_test_cases.title: Each row shows company / title / decision badge / score / date
dupe_test_cases.description: Row layout: company (bold) + title (muted) + decision verdict badge (colored) + "Score: N" + date (right-aligned).
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client with at least one jobfit_run in history
2. Click the Analyses History tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Each row shows: bold company name, muted title, colored verdict badge (Priority Apply=teal / Apply=green / Review=amber / Pass=red), "Score: {N}" dim text, and date in right-aligned dim text. Decision badges use the same colors as the Job Tracker section.

dupe_test_cases.title: Empty state shows "No analyses run yet."
dupe_test_cases.description: When the history array is empty, render a muted single-line message rather than an empty card.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client with zero jobfit_runs
2. Click the Analyses History tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The tab content shows muted text "No analyses run yet." No row cards render.

dupe_test_cases.title: Profile section shows Name + Email read-only and 4 editable fields below
dupe_test_cases.description: Top of the profile card: Name and Email render as read-only rows. Below: a 2×2 grid of editable fields — Job Type (select), Timeline (select), Target Roles (input), Target Locations (input). Below that, 3 full-width coaching note textareas.
dupe_test_cases.steps: 1. Open a client's Profile & Personas tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Profile card shows: header row with NAME / EMAIL read-only values. Then a 2-column grid: JOB TYPE (dropdown), TIMELINE (dropdown), TARGET ROLES (text input), TARGET LOCATIONS (text input). Below: three textareas labeled "Coaching note — roles / locations / companies to avoid", "Coaching note — what does this client do well?", "Coaching note — gaps or challenges to address".

dupe_test_cases.title: Select fields autosave on change; text fields autosave on blur
dupe_test_cases.description: Job Type and Timeline (selects) commit via saveField on every change. Target Roles, Target Locations, and the three coaching notes commit on blur of the field. A "Saving…/Saved" indicator appears next to each field's label.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Profile & Personas tab
2. Change Job Type from current value to "Internship"
3. Edit Target Roles, then click outside the field
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Job Type change: an immediate "Saving…" appears next to the label, then "Saved" after the PATCH resolves, fading after 2 seconds. Target Roles edit: no save until blur; on blur, "Saving…" then "Saved". Each fires a separate PATCH /api/coach/clients/{clientId}/profile with only the changed field.

dupe_test_cases.title: Personas section header shows "(N active, M archived)" count
dupe_test_cases.description: Below the profile card, an eyebrow reads "PERSONAS (N active, M archived)" — archived count omitted if 0.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client with 2 active personas and 1 archived persona
2. Scroll to the personas section
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Blue eyebrow reads "PERSONAS (2 active, 1 archived)". An "+ Add Persona" button is on the right side of the header.

dupe_test_cases.title: Persona card shows name input + Primary badge + version + resume preview
dupe_test_cases.description: Each active persona renders: editable name input (autosave on blur), small orange "Primary" badge if is_default, "vN" version label, first 200 chars of resume_text + ellipsis, and Edit Resume / Set as Primary / Archive buttons.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client with a default persona
2. View its card in the personas section
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Card shows: name input (editable, with the persona name pre-filled), orange "PRIMARY" pill (only on default), "v{N}" right-aligned dim text. Below: resume preview truncated to 200 chars + "…". Three action buttons: "Edit Resume" (blue-tinted), "Set as Primary" (only if not already default), "Archive" (muted).

dupe_test_cases.title: Edit Resume expands inline textarea with explicit Save button
dupe_test_cases.description: Unlike profile fields, the resume textarea does NOT autosave on blur — too large to risk silent partial saves. Save button must be clicked.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "Edit Resume" on a persona card
2. Modify the resume text
3. Click "Save Resume"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Card expands with a labeled "RESUME BODY" textarea pre-filled with the current resume. Save button persists changes via PATCH /personas/{id}; on success, "Saved" indicator briefly appears and the inline edit closes 800ms later.

dupe_test_cases.title: "Archive" moves persona to archived section
dupe_test_cases.description: Click PATCHes {archive: true} on the persona. After refreshPersonas, the card moves below the active list to the archived section.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "Archive" on an active persona
2. Wait for the API call to complete
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The persona disappears from the active section and reappears in an archived section at the bottom (with reduced opacity and an uppercase "ARCHIVED" pill). The personas count in the header updates: active drops by 1, archived increases by 1.

dupe_test_cases.title: Add Persona form has Paste Text / Upload PDF tabs
dupe_test_cases.description: Click "+ Add Persona" reveals a card with persona name input + a 2-tab resume input (Paste Text default; Upload PDF supports .pdf/.docx/.doc/.txt up to 5MB).
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "+ Add Persona"
2. Inspect the form
3. Click the "Upload PDF" tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Card eyebrow reads "NEW PERSONA". Name input + RESUME label with tabs: "Paste Text" (active by default) shows a textarea; clicking "Upload PDF" switches to a file picker accepting .pdf, .docx, .doc, .txt with a 5MB max. Create Persona button at the bottom is disabled when name is empty.

dupe_test_cases.title: Invite modal POSTs to /api/coach/invite with email + access_level + note
dupe_test_cases.description: The "+ Invite" modal on Coach Home is the existing-user invite path. Clicking Send Invite hits /api/coach/invite which creates a pending coach_clients row and sends an email.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. On Coach Home, click "+ Invite"
2. Fill CLIENT EMAIL with an existing SIGNAL user's email
3. Leave ACCESS LEVEL at "Full Access" (default)
4. Optionally fill PERSONAL NOTE
5. Click "Send Invite →"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Network shows POST /api/coach/invite with payload { email, access_level: "full", note }. Modal switches to a success state with eyebrow "INVITE SENT" and body "Invitation delivered". A new row appears in coach_clients with status="invited".

dupe_test_cases.title: Invite success state shows email confirmation + Done button
dupe_test_cases.description: After successful POST, the modal switches view: success eyebrow, message naming the email, single "Done" button that closes the modal and clears state.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Successfully send an invite
2. Inspect the modal
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Modal shows green eyebrow "INVITE SENT", heading "Invitation delivered", and body text "An invitation was sent to {email}. They'll receive a link to accept and connect their account to your coaching dashboard." A single orange "Done" button closes the modal.

dupe_test_cases.title: CreateClientModal POSTs to /api/coach/create-client with intake payload
dupe_test_cases.description: The "+ Create" path is for clients who do NOT yet have a SIGNAL account. The full intake form (name, email, job search details, resume, coaching notes) is captured and the API creates the account + sends an invite email.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. On Coach Home, click "+ Create"
2. Fill First name, Last name, Email
3. Pick a Job Type, enter Target Roles, Target Locations, Timeframe
4. Paste a resume into the textarea
5. Optionally fill coaching notes
6. Click "Create Account & Send Invite →"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Button shows "Creating account..." then a success footer reads "Account created · invite sent" in green. After 2 seconds the modal closes and the My Clients list refreshes. The new client appears with status="invited" in coach_clients.

dupe_test_cases.title: Create Client 409 conflict shows inline email error
dupe_test_cases.description: When the email already exists, /api/coach/create-client returns 409. The modal must surface the error next to the email field — not via a generic banner.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open Create Client modal
2. Enter an email that already exists in client_profiles
3. Submit
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: After submit, an inline error appears below the email input in rose/pink: "An account with this email already exists". The modal stays open; the rest of the form data is preserved.

dupe_test_cases.title: Create Client email-failure case shows amber warning footer
dupe_test_cases.description: When the account is created but the invite email fails to send (data.emailSent === false), footer shows an amber warning instead of green success. Auto-close timeout extends to 4 seconds.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Trigger a successful create-client where the invite email fails (e.g. dev environment without email config)
2. Watch the modal footer
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Footer text reads "Account created but invite failed — contact client directly" in amber. After ~4 seconds (longer than the 2s success path) the modal closes and the list refreshes.

dupe_test_cases.title: Accept-invite page POSTs token to /api/coach/accept-invite
dupe_test_cases.description: The page reads ?token= from the URL and immediately POSTs it. On success, coach_clients.status transitions to "active" and accepted_at is set.
dupe_test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /dashboard/accept-invite?token={valid_token} while signed in as the invited user
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Page shows "PROCESSING — Accepting your coaching invite..." with a spinner. Network shows POST /api/coach/accept-invite with the token. On success, the page transitions to the success state. The coach_clients row for this user moves from status="invited" to "active" with accepted_at set.

dupe_test_cases.title: Accept success routes to Job Tracker vs. Build My Profile based on profile_complete
dupe_test_cases.description: After accepting, the page calls /api/profile and inspects profile_complete. Complete profiles get a "Go to Job Tracker" CTA; incomplete profiles get "Build My Profile" with a different message.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Accept an invite as a user with profile_complete=true → check CTA
2. Accept an invite as a user with profile_complete=false → check CTA
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Complete profile: CTA reads "Go to Job Tracker" and links to /dashboard/tracker. Body includes "Check the Job Tracker tab in your dashboard for any recommendations from your coach." Incomplete profile: CTA reads "Build My Profile" linking to /dashboard. Body includes "Complete your profile so your coach can start sending you personalized job recommendations."

dupe_test_cases.title: Accept-invite with invalid/missing token shows error card
dupe_test_cases.description: No token param → error state with specific copy. Invalid/used token → error with the message from the API response.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to /dashboard/accept-invite (no ?token=)
2. Then try /dashboard/accept-invite?token=fake-token
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: No token: red "ERROR" eyebrow, heading "Invite failed", body "No invite token found. Check your email link and try again.", "Back to Dashboard" CTA. Invalid token: same shell, body shows the API's error message (e.g. "Failed to accept invite. The link may have expired.").

dupe_test_cases.title: Sidebar shows COACHES CENTER group for is_coach=true users
dupe_test_cases.description: When the authenticated profile has is_coach=true, the layout swaps from the D2C nav (My Account / Job Tracker / ResumeRx) to the coach nav (Dashboard / Required Actions / My Clients). Failure means a coach lands in the consumer dashboard.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a coach account (is_coach=true in client_profiles)
2. Wait for the dashboard sidebar to render
3. Look at the leftmost nav column
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The sidebar shows a "COACHES CENTER" group containing exactly three items: Dashboard, Required Actions, My Clients. A second group "ACCOUNT" contains "My Account". A green "Back to SIGNAL →" link is below.

dupe_test_cases.title: Sidebar hides COACHES CENTER group for is_coach=false users
dupe_test_cases.description: A regular consumer (is_coach=false) must never see coach nav items — visibility leak would expose coach-only routes that 403 on access.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a non-coach account (is_coach=false or null)
2. Open the dashboard sidebar
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: No "COACHES CENTER" group is visible. The "DASHBOARD" group is shown instead with three items: My Account, Job Tracker, ResumeRx (Coming Soon).

dupe_test_cases.title: Coach password sign-in redirects to /dashboard/coach
dupe_test_cases.description: In dev (NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH=true), password sign-in checks is_coach BEFORE profile_complete and routes coaches to /dashboard/coach rather than /dashboard/tracker. This mirrors the server-side magic-link logic.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open the dashboard sign-in screen with NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH=true
2. Enter a coach account email and the dev password
3. Click "Sign in with password"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: After successful sign-in, the URL changes to /dashboard/coach (the Coach Home page). Not /dashboard, not /dashboard/tracker.

dupe_test_cases.title: Non-coach hitting /dashboard/coach sees ACCESS DENIED card
dupe_test_cases.description: The Coach Home page calls /api/coach/home which returns 403 for non-coaches. The page renders a dedicated denial card rather than crashing or redirecting silently.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a non-coach account
2. Manually navigate to /dashboard/coach
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: A centered card appears with eyebrow text "ACCESS DENIED", heading "Coach access required", and the line "Your account does not have coach permissions. Contact support to request access."

dupe_test_cases.title: My Clients nav item stays highlighted on /clients/[id] child route
dupe_test_cases.description: The My Clients item has matchPrefix=true so deep links into a client dashboard still highlight the parent nav. Without it the active state would drop when opening a client.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a coach
2. Click "My Clients" in the sidebar
3. Click "Open →" on a client card to enter /dashboard/coach/clients/[clientId]
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: In the sidebar, "My Clients" remains highlighted (orange border + orange text) while on the client detail page.

dupe_test_cases.title: Header strip shows today's date eyebrow and "Welcome back, {firstName}"
dupe_test_cases.description: The page opens with a personalized greeting derived from the coach's first name (from /api/coach/home). Date eyebrow uses long weekday + month + day format.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Sign in as a coach
2. Land on /dashboard/coach
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Top of page shows an orange uppercase date eyebrow (e.g. "MONDAY, MAY 18") above a heading reading "Welcome back, {firstName}" with the first name colored orange.

dupe_test_cases.title: Metrics bar renders 8 tiles in a 4-column grid
dupe_test_cases.description: The metrics bar is a 4×2 layout — Row 1: Active clients, Total applications, Interviewing, Offers in flight. Row 2: Avg interview rate, Pending recs, Active prospects (placeholder), Clients per phase (placeholder).
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Land on /dashboard/coach
2. Inspect the metrics bar below the header strip
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: 8 tiles render in a 4-column CSS grid. Row 1 shows: Active clients / Total applications / Interviewing (blue value) / Offers in flight (green value). Row 2 shows: Avg interview rate / Pending recs (orange value) / Active prospects "—" muted / Clients per phase "—" muted.

dupe_test_cases.title: Avg interview rate averages only over clients with submitted apps
dupe_test_cases.description: Clients with zero submitted apps are excluded from the average to avoid dragging it toward 0. Only clients with applications > 0 AND (interviewing + offers + rejected) > 0 are counted.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Have a coach with 3 clients: A has 5 apps + 2 interviews, B has 0 apps, C has 3 apps but 0 status changes
2. Land on /dashboard/coach
3. Check the "Avg interview rate" tile
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Avg interview rate equals the mean across A only (B excluded because applications=0, C excluded because no status changes yet). Not averaged across A+B+C.

dupe_test_cases.title: Action Items and Engagement Signals render side-by-side with orange + blue accents
dupe_test_cases.description: The two sections sit in a CSS grid (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(360px, 1fr))) so they appear side-by-side at desktop widths and stack at narrower widths. Action Items uses an orange 2px top accent strip; Engagement Signals uses blue.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Land on /dashboard/coach at a viewport ≥ 760px wide
2. Locate the two paired sections below the metrics bar
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: "Action Items" (left, orange icon + 2px orange top strip) and "Engagement Signals" (right, blue icon + 2px blue top strip) render side-by-side as equal-width columns.

dupe_test_cases.title: Action Items section caps at 5 items with "+ N more in Required Actions →" footer
dupe_test_cases.description: Filtered to priority=urgent,this_week and capped at 5. Items beyond the cap collapse into a single footer link to the Required Actions tab.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Coach has 8 urgent or this_week action_item notes across all clients
2. Land on /dashboard/coach
3. Look at the Action Items section
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: 5 action item rows are visible. Below the last row, an orange link reads "+ 3 more in Required Actions →" and clicking it navigates to /dashboard/coach/required-actions.

dupe_test_cases.title: Engagement Signals shows 6 distinct heuristic kinds with color-coded labels
dupe_test_cases.description: Each ActionItem.kind has a label and color: no_login (orange "Inactive"), rec_pending_review (blue "Awaiting review"), moved_interviewing (purple "Status change"), moved_rejected (red "Rejection"), offer_no_followup (green "Offer"), poor_fit_no_rec (amber "Low-fit app").
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Seed a coach whose clients trigger at least one of each of the 6 rules
2. Land on /dashboard/coach
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Engagement Signals section lists rows where each row has a colored small uppercase label badge matching the kind, followed by the message text and "Nd" (days elapsed) on the right.

dupe_test_cases.title: Today's schedule renders placeholder copy
dupe_test_cases.description: The Today's Schedule section is intentionally empty pending calendar integration. It must show the placeholder, not a blank or error state.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Land on /dashboard/coach
2. Find the section with the calendar icon
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: A dashed-bordered card reads "Calendar integration coming soon" in italic with the sub-line "Sessions, prep blocks, and mock interviews will appear here".

dupe_test_cases.title: My clients section caps at 5 with "Show all N →" footer
dupe_test_cases.description: The My Clients summary on the home page caps at 5 clients (sorted by updates_since_visit DESC, then attention_level, then name). Beyond 5, a footer link goes to the full list.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Coach has 8 active clients
2. Land on /dashboard/coach
3. Scroll to the My clients section
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: 5 client rows visible. Below them an orange "Show all 8 →" link navigates to /dashboard/coach/clients.

dupe_test_cases.title: "+ Create" opens CreateClientModal with full intake
dupe_test_cases.description: The Create button in the My Clients section header opens the modal that hits /api/coach/create-client. Failure here blocks the new-user onboarding path entirely.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Land on /dashboard/coach
2. In the My Clients section header, click "+ Create"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: A modal opens with header "Create Client Account" and subheading "Set up SIGNAL for your client — an invite will be sent automatically". The form has First Name, Last Name, Email, Job Type, Target Roles, Target Locations, Timeframe, a Resume tab group (Paste Text / Upload PDF), and three coaching note textareas.

dupe_test_cases.title: "+ Invite" opens invite modal for existing-user flow
dupe_test_cases.description: The Invite button targets clients who already have a SIGNAL account. It collects email + access level + optional personal note and POSTs to /api/coach/invite.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Land on /dashboard/coach
2. In the My Clients section header, click "+ Invite"

dupe_test_cases.title: Clicking an Action Item row navigates to that client's dashboard

Target Roles edit: no save until blur; on blur, "Saving…" then "Saved". Each fires a separate PATCH /api/coach/clients/{clientId}/profile with only the changed field.

dupe_test_cases.title: Personas section header shows "(N active, M archived)" count
dupe_test_cases.description: Below the profile card, an eyebrow reads "PERSONAS (N active, M archived)" — archived count omitted if 0.
dupe_test_cases.steps:

2. Scroll to the personas section
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Blue eyebrow reads "PERSONAS (2 active, 1 archived)". An "+ Add Persona" button is on the right side of the header.

dupe_test_cases.title: Persona card shows name input + Primary badge + version + resume preview
dupe_test_cases.description: Each active persona renders: editable name input (autosave on blur), small orange "Primary" badge if is_default, "vN" version label, first 200 chars of resume_text + ellipsis, and Edit Resume / Set as Primary / Archive buttons.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open a client with a default persona
2. View its card in the personas section
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Card shows: name input (editable, with the persona name pre-filled), orange "PRIMARY" pill (only on default), "v{N}" right-aligned dim text. Below: resume preview truncated to 200 chars + "…". Three action buttons: "Edit Resume" (blue-tinted), "Set as Primary" (only if not already default), "Archive" (muted).

dupe_test_cases.title: Edit Resume expands inline textarea with explicit Save button
dupe_test_cases.description: Unlike profile fields, the resume textarea does NOT autosave on blur — too large to risk silent partial saves. Save button must be clicked.
dupe_test_cases.steps:

2. Modify the resume text
3. Click "Save Resume"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Card expands with a labeled "RESUME BODY" textarea pre-filled with the current resume. Save button persists changes via PATCH /personas/{id}; on success, "Saved" indicator briefly appears and the inline edit closes 800ms later.

dupe_test_cases.title: "Archive" moves persona to archived section
dupe_test_cases.description: Click PATCHes {archive: true} on the persona. After refreshPersonas, the card moves below the active list to the archived section.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "Archive" on an active persona
2. Wait for the API call to complete
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: The persona disappears from the active section and reappears in an archived section at the bottom (with reduced opacity and an uppercase "ARCHIVED" pill). The personas count in the header updates: active drops by 1, archived increases by 1.

dupe_test_cases.title: Add Persona form has Paste Text / Upload PDF tabs
dupe_test_cases.description: Click "+ Add Persona" reveals a card with persona name input + a 2-tab resume input (Paste Text default; Upload PDF supports .pdf/.docx/.doc/.txt up to 5MB).
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Click "+ Add Persona"
2. Inspect the form
3. Click the "Upload PDF" tab
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Card eyebrow reads "NEW PERSONA". Name input + RESUME label with tabs: "Paste Text" (active by default) shows a textarea; clicking "Upload PDF" switches to a file picker accepting .pdf, .docx, .doc, .txt with a 5MB max. Create Persona button at the bottom is disabled when name is empty.

dupe_test_cases.title: Invite modal POSTs to /api/coach/invite with email + access_level + note
dupe_test_cases.description: The "+ Invite" modal on Coach Home is the existing-user invite path. Clicking Send Invite hits /api/coach/invite which creates a pending coach_clients row and sends an email.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. On Coach Home, click "+ Invite"
2. Fill CLIENT EMAIL with an existing SIGNAL user's email
3. Leave ACCESS LEVEL at "Full Access" (default)
4. Optionally fill PERSONAL NOTE
5. Click "Send Invite →"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Network shows POST /api/coach/invite with payload { email, access_level: "full", note }. Modal switches to a success state with eyebrow "INVITE SENT" and body "Invitation delivered". A new row appears in coach_clients with status="invited".

dupe_test_cases.title: Invite success state shows email confirmation + Done button
dupe_test_cases.description: After successful POST, the modal switches view: success eyebrow, message naming the email, single "Done" button that closes the modal and clears state.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Successfully send an invite
2. Inspect the modal
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Modal shows green eyebrow "INVITE SENT", heading "Invitation delivered", and body text "An invitation was sent to {email}. They'll receive a link to accept and connect their account to your coaching dashboard." A single orange "Done" button closes the modal.

dupe_test_cases.title: CreateClientModal POSTs to /api/coach/create-client with intake payload
dupe_test_cases.description: The "+ Create" path is for clients who do NOT yet have a SIGNAL account. The full intake form (name, email, job search details, resume, coaching notes) is captured and the API creates the account + sends an invite email.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. On Coach Home, click "+ Create"
2. Fill First name, Last name, Email
3. Pick a Job Type, enter Target Roles, Target Locations, Timeframe
4. Paste a resume into the textarea
5. Optionally fill coaching notes
6. Click "Create Account & Send Invite →"
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Button shows "Creating account..." then a success footer reads "Account created · invite sent" in green. After 2 seconds the modal closes and the My Clients list refreshes. The new client appears with status="invited" in coach_clients.

dupe_test_cases.title: Create Client 409 conflict shows inline email error
dupe_test_cases.description: When the email already exists, /api/coach/create-client returns 409. The modal must surface the error next to the email field — not via a generic banner.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Open Create Client modal
2. Enter an email that already exists in client_profiles
3. Submit
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: After submit, an inline error appears below the email input in rose/pink: "An account with this email already exists". The modal stays open; the rest of the form data is preserved.

dupe_test_cases.title: Create Client email-failure case shows amber warning footer
dupe_test_cases.description: When the account is created but the invite email fails to send (data.emailSent === false), footer shows an amber warning instead of green success. Auto-close timeout extends to 4 seconds.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Trigger a successful create-client where the invite email fails (e.g. dev environment without email config)
2. Watch the modal footer
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Footer text reads "Account created but invite failed — contact client directly" in amber. After ~4 seconds (longer than the 2s success path) the modal closes and the list refreshes.

dupe_test_cases.title: Accept-invite page POSTs token to /api/coach/accept-invite
dupe_test_cases.description: The page reads ?token= from the URL and immediately POSTs it. On success, coach_clients.status transitions to "active" and accepted_at is set.
dupe_test_cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /dashboard/accept-invite?token={valid_token} while signed in as the invited user
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Page shows "PROCESSING — Accepting your coaching invite..." with a spinner. Network shows POST /api/coach/accept-invite with the token. On success, the page transitions to the success state. The coach_clients row for this user moves from status="invited" to "active" with accepted_at set.

dupe_test_cases.title: Accept success routes to Job Tracker vs. Build My Profile based on profile_complete
dupe_test_cases.description: After accepting, the page calls /api/profile and inspects profile_complete. Complete profiles get a "Go to Job Tracker" CTA; incomplete profiles get "Build My Profile" with a different message.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Accept an invite as a user with profile_complete=true → check CTA
2. Accept an invite as a user with profile_complete=false → check CTA
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: Complete profile: CTA reads "Go to Job Tracker" and links to /dashboard/tracker. Body includes "Check the Job Tracker tab in your dashboard for any recommendations from your coach." Incomplete profile: CTA reads "Build My Profile" linking to /dashboard. Body includes "Complete your profile so your coach can start sending you personalized job recommendations."

dupe_test_cases.title: Accept-invite with invalid/missing token shows error card
dupe_test_cases.description: No token param → error state with specific copy. Invalid/used token → error with the message from the API response.
dupe_test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to /dashboard/accept-invite (no ?token=)
2. Then try /dashboard/accept-invite?token=fake-token
dupe_test_cases.expected_result: No token: red "ERROR" eyebrow, heading "Invite failed", body "No invite token found. Check your email link and try again.", "Back to Dashboard" CTA. Invalid token: same shell, body shows the API's error message (e.g. "Failed to accept invite. The link may have expired.").
